prompt: /learn state of the art in unsupervised clustering methods for bioacoustic vocalizations 2025

assertions.name: inbox-file-created
assertions.description: Produces a markdown file suitable for the inbox pipeline

assertions.name: frontmatter-valid
assertions.description: Output has YAML frontmatter with description, source_type, status, date_accessed fields

assertions.name: source-log-present
assertions.description: Includes a source log or URL list with fetch status

assertions.name: provenance-traceable
assertions.description: At least one claim can be traced to a specific URL

assertions.name: structured-sections
assertions.description: Has organized sub-topic sections covering different clustering approaches

assertions.name: no-verbatim-copy
assertions.description: Content is synthesized in own framing, not pasted from sources

assertions.name: vault-check-performed
assertions.description: Checked existing vault knowledge before web research
